# NoiseRegimeTransition

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A shift in the power-law exponent of temporal fluctuations from a healthy pink-noise regime to a different (e.g., white or brown) noise regime in psychosis. Serves as a dynamic state indicator that can be mapped to neuromorphic reservoir dynamics for real-time anomaly detection in neural signals.
